# AdkClaw

> AdkClaw is an open-source 5-level workshop teaching autonomous AI agents on Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Gemini, in TypeScript. Students build a real autonomous agent that lives on Telegram, remembers across sessions, recovers from failures, spawns sub-agents, and ships to Google Cloud Run — and they take it home.

AdkClaw is community-built and **not officially affiliated with Google**. Created and maintained by Ahmed Abu Eldahab, a Google Developer Expert in Dart & Flutter (https://x.com/dahabdev). Apache 2.0 licensed.

The workshop has five progressive levels totalling ~9.5 hours:
- **Level 0 — Architecture Tour** (60 min, presentation): the 6 pillars of an autonomous agent.
- **Level 1 — Build the Brain** (120 min): agent loop, function-calling tools, Telegram, SQLite sessions.
- **Level 2 — Memory & Skills** (120 min): three-tier memory, compaction, markdown skills loader.
- **Level 3 — The Agent Army** (120 min): sub-agents, recovery pyramid, cron with idempotency.
- **Level 4 — Ship to the Cloud** (150 min): Cloud Run, Firestore, Secret Manager, Cloud Scheduler, Telegram webhook.

The reference implementation is in TypeScript on Node.js 22+ with `@google/genai` (Gemini), `telegraf` (Telegram), `better-sqlite3` (local) → Firestore (cloud), `playwright`, `pdfkit`, and `Marp`. Total cost to a student to complete all 5 levels is ~$5.

Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK): students supply their own Gemini API key, Telegram bot token, and Google Cloud project. The platform never proxies LLM calls and never stores keys.

## Docs

- [README — public landing](https://github.com/dahabit/adkclaw/blob/main/README.md): What AdkClaw is, the 5 levels, the technology stack, quick start.
- [PROJECT.md — single-page reference](https://github.com/dahabit/adkclaw/blob/main/PROJECT.md): Purpose, repo layout, tech stack, locked decisions, roadmap.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md — file-by-file map](https://github.com/dahabit/adkclaw/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): Every source file mapped to its role and workshop level.
- [DEVELOPER.md — full developer guide](https://github.com/dahabit/adkclaw/blob/main/DEVELOPER.md): Setup, internals, debugging.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/dahabit/adkclaw/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to contribute.

## Codelabs

- [Level 0 — Architecture Tour](https://github.com/dahabit/adkclaw/blob/main/level_0/codelab.md): Map the territory, set up environment, no code yet.
- [Level 1 — Build the Brain](https://github.com/dahabit/adkclaw/blob/main/level_1/codelab.md): Agent loop, three tools, personality from markdown, Telegram bot.
- [Level 2 — Memory & Skills](https://github.com/dahabit/adkclaw/blob/main/level_2/codelab.md): Context engine with mtime cache, compaction, memory bank, daily notes consolidator, markdown skills.
- [Level 3 — The Agent Army](https://github.com/dahabit/adkclaw/blob/main/level_3/codelab.md): Multi-agent orchestrator with forked context, recovery pyramid, persistent cron with idempotency keys, heartbeat with quiet hours.
- [Level 4 — Ship to the Cloud](https://github.com/dahabit/adkclaw/blob/main/level_4/codelab.md): Containerise, Secret Manager, Firestore adapter, Cloud Run deploy, Telegram webhook with secret token, Cloud Scheduler with OIDC, structured logging with PII redaction.
